Use case: illustration-story. A production sprite ATLAS, one transparent landscape1536x1024 PNG divided into an EXACT 3 columns by 2 rows equal512x512 grid, no drawn grid or labels. Each cell contains ONE DISTINCT separately painted phantom of Mochi's CAT forearm ending in rounded black clawed toes; chest-end fades into horizontal soft watercolor motion streaks. No head/body, no human anatomy, no overhead arms, no duplicate stamp. The six cells depict one alternating swipe cycle left to right then next row: left gather, left strike, left follow, right gather, right strike, right follow. Different wrist silhouette, yaw, forearm perspective and FORESHORTENING in EACH cell. Horizontal positions within each cell change: x55%,35%,22%,45%,65%,78%, y55%; clear padding so no cell bleed. Gather paws are frontal/foreshortened short broad arms, strikes are three-quarter forward rakes, follows are edge-on receding smaller paws. Paint ORIGINAL six drawings, never copies/translated/mirrored versions. BIG water-diluted wet washes, rounded soft dabs, cloudy apricot/cream/smoky slate forearm with BLACK toes, sparse cream/sage horizontal speed streaks. Broad soft blur in trails, readable knuckles. Genuinely transparent background and gutters, no paper, texture overlay, scenery, UI or text. Keep entire arm in each512x512 cell. Small distant thin forearms viewed mostly sideways, narrow paws and long hazy pale horizontal trails. Restrained smoky/slate marks. Each arm fills about65% cell width.

sequence: Six discrete alternating left/right poses; three phantom planes use distinct six-cell atlases with staggered angular gates. No continuous lateral limb translation.
alpha: Original alpha retained. Body atlas is a deterministic packing derivative; individual masters and runtime frames remain byte identical.

packing.method: Canvas drawImage downsample/pack only; no keying, recoloring or generated-content edits.
